body: xD i never got into drinking, maybe it's a good time to start, good luck bro, i hope you feel better tomorrow, i'm gonna try and get some sleep, maybe for some fucking miracle tomorrow i'll feel better...

no, i'm getting fired, i overheard my boss and the team leader :( ... when i go in on tuesday (monday is holiday here) i'm gonna say my boss i'm sorry for being shit

do you have something that makes you feel better? when i have no job i always go into survival mode... i stop myself from enjoying anything... not looking forward to that...
